title: 8BitDo controller description v1
description: One file per controller model, at crates/controller-core/controllers/<model>/description.json. The loader also checks what this schema cannot: button ids are unique, every button has a label for exactly the listed modes, every config port names a listed mode, every limit has min <= max, and no extra output reuses a button id, 'disabled' or 'unrecognised', view ids are unique, and every view's SVG is embedded. Each view SVG declares viewBox="0 0 <width> <height>", paints only in #000000, #ffffff or none (in a fill or stroke attribute, or in style), uses only svg, g, defs, path, circle, rect and ellipse elements, and has no class or transform attribute. The loader skips title and metadata elements and Inkscape and Sodipodi elements with everything inside them. A path, circle or rect with a data-button="<button id>" attribute is that button's hotspot: it must lie inside the viewBox, name a listed button, and appear at most once per view. Every button needs a hotspot in at least one view. How to draw a view: docs/controller-views.md.

short_name.description: Short model name for tight places, such as the controller picker.

model_ids.description: Model ids the START_CONFIG reply carries.

config_ports.description: The config interface of every current mode, one per USB id.

limits.description: Name and macro length ranges. They must equal the profile and macro schemas. The ranges of settings sit on each setting.

settings.description: The settings tabs, in display order, after the Buttons tab.

views.description: Drawings of the controller, in display order.

interface.description: USB interface number whose hidraw node carries the config reports.

framing.description: plain: report 0x81 out, 0x02 in. wrapped: Nintendo-id framing with an 01 66 AA prefix. length: older pads such as the Pro 2, with a length byte after the 0x81 and plain replies.

write_via.description: Optional. The mode to flip the controller to before a write, when this mode takes no writes in place. That mode needs a port of its own without write_via.

needs_keepalive.description: Optional, false when omitted. True when the controller resets and reconnects in this mode while no program holds its event node open. 8B then offers a udev rule that matches this USB id and starts a unit to hold the node.

trigger_kind.description: analog: min and max range. threshold: one press point.

extra_outputs.description: Outputs beyond the buttons and 'disabled', which every mode has.

SettingsPage.description: One settings tab. Each value is named by a JSON pointer into the profile, such as /sticks/left_min_pct. Two tabs may share an id when their modes differ.

modes.description: The modes that show this tab. Omit it for every mode.

Slider.description: One number, or the two ends of a range when high is set. unit follows the value, such as %; without one the value shows as <value> of <max>.

Flag.description: One on-or-off setting. excludes lists the flags of the same mode that may not be on together with it.

id.description: Canonical position name, as in button_mappings.source and .target. Never shown.

labels.description: Name shown to the user, one per listed mode.

can_be_remapped.description: A button mapping may give this button an output other than its own press.

can_be_output.description: This button's press may be the output of another button.

id.description: View name, unique within the description. Never shown.

svg.description: File name of the SVG, next to description.json. Line art in #000000 on #ffffff, which the UI swaps per theme. Button shapes carry data-button attributes.
